snippet.title: Descent of Lunaris - Announcement Trailer 2.0 - Best Indie Games Winter Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
An updated version of our announcement trailer for Clemmy's Best Indie Games Winter Showcase that took place on December 2nd, 2025. 

Investigate a signal emanating from deep within the moon and fight through a dark reflection of human nature. Are you being tested or punished for the actions of humanity? Descent of Lunaris is a classic dungeon-crawling turn-based RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824720/Descent_Of_Lunaris/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

The year is 2070. A lunar mining operation picks up a mysterious signal emanating from the inside of the moon. Once the signal is discovered, all the automatons and electronic systems in the operation go haywire, killing a large portion of the base’s inhabitants.

A team of highly specialized operatives from all over the world are called in to investigate the disturbance and find the cause. What they discover through this journey into the unknown will change the course of human history.

As they descend through the world inside the moon they are confronted with twisted reflections of civilization, structures, and mythology we know to be our own. Are they being tested, or punished for the nature of humanity?

Where will this descent take them, and what lies at the bottom?

Descent of Lunaris is a love letter to classic dungeon-crawling RPGs of the past. Descend into the depths and find the source of the signal that summoned your mission. Not everything is as it seems...

- - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Explore the moon in this classic inspired grid-based dungeon crawling RPG. Customize your party at the moon base and explore the dungeon levels to find what lies in waiting beneath the surface.

Meet Strange Characters
Find and befriend allies or make enemies within each dungeon for access to more loot, rewards, and information that will aid in your exploration of new areas.

Create Your Perfect Team
Customize your operatives' abilities, unlock new subclasses, change up your gear, and upgrade your characters to customize your play experience and tackle your enemies in a style that suits you.

Immersive First-Person Exploration 
Travel through the world beneath the lunar surface and explore the dungeons to find out what lies beneath. Defeat powerful enemies to level up your team and gain access to new areas.

Dynamic Combat Encounters
Fight your way through enemy encounters with traditional formation combat and tactical grid based combat. Strategize your encounters to protect your team and get the upper hand.


- - - - - 

Do you have what it takes to see what lies beneath?
